overall: Eight live rows confirmed or usable; two discrepancies: the Justia Constitution says it is current through the 2005 session (recorded as no date), and the regs probe's expected text is split by a line-break hyphen in the PDF ('Depart- ment'). Justia's currency has moved (Supreme Court to Sept. 9, 2026), and its Court of Appeals listing lags about 3 months, which isn't recorded. Both www.sccourts.org rows are still blocked. C-Track provenance is settled: robots.txt is 404, and the Judicial Department's own 2014 accountability report says it added C-Track to its website, so it's usable for docket events only. The State Library advance sheets are an acceptable tier-1 publication (the State Library's own statutory depository collection), but the PDF bitstreams return 403, so they stay link-only. No regex misses or false routes.
